releases.name: Storage Hunter Simulator
releases.summary:
Step up to the challenge and take a risk in the world of Storage Hunter Simulator, where you'll compete against others for the ultimate prize - garages filled with hidden treasures waiting to be discovered! In this exciting game, you'll have the chance to showcase your skills and become a giant of the storage market!

In this simulation game, you'll need to master the art of auctions, selling valuable items to wealthy collectors, and improving your skills as an appraiser to stay ahead of the competition. But that's just the beginning - the storage empire is waiting for you!

releases.name: Gothic 3
releases.summary: You have saved the island Khorinis from the forces of evil in Gothic I and Gothic II. Now it is time to travel to the realms of the mainland. Invading Orcs have enslaved the human kingdom. There are but a few free humans in the icy north and the southern desert and a handful of rebels hiding in the forests and mountains of Midland. You may either join the rebellion or serve the Orcish Usurpers but you will ultimately tip the scales and decide the outcome of the last war to save humanity. There is no simple linear story in Gothic III - every game will be different and unique - but all will ultimately lead to you deciding the fate of Myrtana.

releases.name: Tales of Lagoona: Orphans of the Ocean
releases.summary: Welcome to the magical undersea world of Lagoona and the town of Coral Bay. New Anemone Orphanage is in trouble of being shut down, and it’s up to you to save it! • DIVE INTO BREATHTAKING LOCATIONS UNDER THE SEA! Look for valuable items, buy and sell, and upgrade your oceanic orphanage! Test your skills with tropical minigames and swim from challenge to challenge! • MEET A UNIQUE CAST OF CHARACTERS! Encounter endearing fish figures along the way! There are tons of bursting personalities to play with in your underwater excursions! • FIND ITEMS QUICK FOR A BIGGER BONUS! Gather items and send them to the local market under the sea! Find them fast for great coin bonuses and use your coins for paint, playgrounds, landscaping, and more! • HELP ISABELLE THE MERMAID SAVE THE ORPHANS! Become enchanted by beautiful graphics and a stunning soundtrack. Make your way through a heartwarming tale that is filled with fun and humor! TRY IT FREE, THEN UNLOCK THE FULL ADVENTURE FROM WITHIN THE GAME! *** Discover more from Big Fish! *** Check out our entire game library with our Game Finder app here: http://bigfi.sh/bfggamefinder Sign up for our newsletter and never miss a new release or promotion again: http://bigfi.sh/iSplashNewsletter Big Fish is the leading global marketplace to discover and enjoy casual games. You can enjoy our virtually endless selection of games anytime, anywhere — on your PC, Mac, mobile phone, or tablet. Learn more at bigfishgames.com! Become a fan on Facebook: http://www.facebook.com/BigFishGamesMobile Follow us on Twitter: http://bigfi.sh/BigFishTwitter

releases.name: A Fold Apart: Recrafted
releases.summary:
The award-winning puzzle game, A Fold Apart, has been Recrafted with new art, new music, new game mechanics, two bonus chapters, and a brand new epilogue!

After career choices force them along separate paths, a Teacher and Architect vow to make their long-distance relationship work at any cost. Experience both sides of their story as the couple navigates the complexities of (mis)communication and the emotional ups and downs that separation brings. By flipping, folding, unfolding, and rotating the paper puzzles in their handcrafted worlds, you can help the couple overcome the emotional barriers of their relationship — but will love endure...? 

Featuring:
- A relatable, true-to-life story of a long-distance relationship.
- Over eighty handcrafted paper folding puzzles.
- Beautiful 3D graphics with a tactile, “homemade” paper aesthetic.
- The ability to choose the couple that best represents you!

releases.name: The Floor Above
releases.summary: A claustrophobic anomaly-horror game where you can only turn, blink, and decide: is it real or not? Survive five endings and uncover Mike’s story.

releases.name: Grimlord
releases.summary: Grimlord is a dark fantasy action RPG built for VR. Use every type of weaponry and armaments with full customization and limitless move sets to annihilate anyone who dares to stand between you and your destiny

releases.name: Darkness and Flame: Enemy in Reflection
releases.summary: Something wasn't right when Alice woke up from a dream that felt all too real. Her mother assured her that there was nothing wrong, but it wasn't long before Alice learned the truth. She was only trying to do the right thing, but the right thing went very wrong, and now the monster that she accidentally unleashed must be stopped! To make matters worse, her friends were the most recent victims of the monster's curse, so she'll have to set out on her own this time. Help Alice explore beautiful vistas to find long-forgotten secrets, solve puzzles, and collect the tools to stop the ancient evil in this fantastic Hidden-Object Puzzle Adventure!

releases.name: Final Apex
releases.summary: Get ready for the ultimate adrenaline rush in "Final Apex," an arcade racing game set in the near future where speed knows no bounds! Step into the driver's seat of seven unique and powerful cars and it's time to unleash the full potential of futuristic racing!

releases.name: One More Delve
releases.summary:
One More Delve is an intense, physics-driven dungeon crawler adventure. Fight, loot, and survive in up to 3 player co-op as you delve in the dungeons.

Return to the social hub to craft gear, talk about your adventures, and prepare for your next dungeon.

releases.name: The Spotter: Dig or Die
releases.summary: Dig by day, fight by night in this blend of mining and Tower Defense. As the last Spotter at a ruined gas station, hold back mutant hordes, scavenge the wasteland, and repair your receiver to capture the President’s vital message and humanity’s last hope.

releases.name: What Do You Meme? The Video Game
releases.summary: The smash-hit card game has gone digital! What Do You Meme?® The Video Game brings internet humor to the living room. Use your phone as a controller to battle your friends and build hilarious memes!

releases.name: One Hop Further
releases.summary: Hop higher. Don't die. A pixel-art arcade jumper: climb row by row through five worlds, outrun the rising void and beat your own records. Unlock over 100 characters, draw your own hero and play on keyboard, mouse, controller or touch.

releases.name: Prizma Puzzle Classic 3
releases.summary: The third installment in the addictive sci-fi puzzle series brings 28 cleverly designed levels and new puzzle mechanics. Guide an energy beam from point A to point B, using interactive objects with unique functions to shape your route. Plan each move and overcome increasingly challenging puzzles.

releases.name: Not to Spec: A Dystopian Factory Inspection Game
releases.summary: The Republic of Grisalia is a small, grey, very tidy country. At State Toy Factory No. 4, "Bright Tomorrow", they make rubber ducks, spinning tops and toy soldiers, and you decide which ones ship.Every morning a sheet arrives with the day's rules. You lift the piece off the belt, check it under the magnifier, compare it to the spec sheet and bring the stamp down. Get it wrong and it comes out of your pay. Get it right often enough and you're promoted.Meanwhile the country is changing. A Ministry of Childhood and Defense is formed "for efficiency". The duck mold turns out to be good for something else, because the Plan does not approve new molds. Nobody at the factory says the word weapon. They say unit, filling, order.At home Ofelia and little Trini leave notes on the fridge, and Lino writes from the front. The paycheck doesn't always stretch.- Inspect products that change with your promotions and with the news.- Find the flaw: seams, colors, serial numbers, parts that shouldn't be there.- Choose a section each time you're promoted. In the end, the Biological Department or the Scientific one.- Seven endings. None of them tells you whether you did well.- Everything happens on your desk: the newspaper, the radio, the filing cabinet, the payslip.

releases.name: Ritebound
releases.summary: Guide a group of cultists to a mysterious portal! Place boxes, build bridges and stairs, use trampolines, avoid deadly traps, and find the right path through 40 puzzle-platforming levels.

releases.name: ELO 1100 Chess
releases.summary:
Play from beginners level to top level ELO 1100 (very good level, if you beat your device here, respect!) in this high quality Chess Game Engine.

Complete chess game logic available including castle move, en-passant move, pawn promotion (to knight/bishop/rook/queen), piece move rule, undo move, redo move, detecting if chess game is finished by checkmate or draw by fiftymoverule, three fold repetitions, insufficient materials, stalemate and extensible by draw agreement, timeout, and surrender.

Calculate the change in position score after each move, as display on the black and white bar located right side of the GUI, letting you visualize the leading colour on the board and how far you are against your opponent on the board position

If you need only one Chess Game, this one is for you.

releases.name: Scary Hot Dogs
releases.summary: Scary Hot Dogs is a horror game where you run a small hot dog stand, prepare orders, and serve creepy customers. Complete tasks, earn money, and survive terrifying night shifts filled with strange encounters, unexpected scares, and mysterious events. Not every customer is here for a hot dog...

releases.name: Escape: Immersion
releases.summary: Escape: Immersion is a cinematic 2.5D horror adventure set inside a collapsing underwater military base. Explore flooded corridors, solve environmental puzzles, evade deadly traps, and uncover your past.

releases.name: Geo Book
releases.summary:
THINK YOU KNOW THE WORLD? PROVE IT!
Welcome to Geo Book an engaging geography game that turns exploring the world into a fun adventure! Travel across continents, discover fascinating places, challenge your memory and put your geographical knowledge to the test through a variety of exciting mini-games.

9 GAME MODES, COUNTLESS CHALLENGES
Geo Book offers unique game modes, each bringing a different twist to your journey around the globe. Explore the world in World Tour, put your skills to the test in Guess the Country, organize treasures in Souvenir Sort and experience even more geographical challenges in Take Me Somewhere, World Puzzle, Match the Flag, Passport Please, Higher or Lower, and Pin It. From famous landmarks and national flags to capitals, populations and surprising geographical facts, every challenge offers something new to discover!

FROM BEGINNER TO MR. WORLDWIIDE
Every great explorer starts somewhere! Earn points, improve your skills and progress through 30 unlockable ranks. Begin your journey as a Baby, rise through titles such as Traveler, Explorer, Scholar, Expert or Master and work your way toward the ultimate achievement: Mr. Worldwide!

CHALLENGE YOURSELF AND COMPETE
Take on timed challenges, aim for higher scores and climb the leaderboards. Join Daily and Weekly Challenges for new opportunities to prove your skills or jump into Practice Mode to sharpen your geographical knowledge at your own pace. Whether you're a curious beginner or a seasoned geography expert, Geo Book offers a rewarding journey filled with discoveries, challenges and milestones.

FEATURES:
- 9 game modes offering a variety of fun geography challenges featuring countries, flags, capitals, cities, landmarks and more
- Online leaderboards to compete for the highest scores
- Practice Mode to learn, explore and improve at your own pace
- 30 unlockable ranks to progress through, from Baby to Mr. Worldwide
- Daily and Weekly Challenges to keep your geographical skills sharp
- Colorful visuals and intuitive gameplay that make exploring the world fun and accessible
- Fun for all skill levels, from curious newcomers to geography enthusiasts

Your journey around the world starts here. Open your Geo Book and prove you've got what it takes to become a geography legend!

releases.name: The Alters: Complete Edition
releases.summary: STRANDED BUT NOT ALONE. Jan Dolski is a simple worker who faces impossible odds. Stranded alone on a distant planet, his only hope for survival is to employ additional helping hands on board his mobile base. Improvising as he goes, Jan uses the local Rapidium substance to create alternate versions of himself: THE ALTERS. Includes: Base Game, Last Variable DLC, 4 Deluxe Outfits.

releases.name: Catgirl Fantasy: Oath of the Night Sky
releases.summary: A classic turn-based RPG with feline companions. Explore a pixel-art world, uncover the red moon's curse, and plan each move in command-based battles. Grow stronger with every weapon and spell you use, follow keywords from conversations, and discover hidden dungeons.

releases.name: The Firemen 2: Pete & Danny
releases.summary: Ever wanted to be hero? Here's your chance in this solid sequel to the art of firefighting. Pete and Danny are comrades in arms, ready to help trapped victims out of terrifying fires. The action is set in the center of a burning theme park. You'll be briefed on your mission and off you go. Two types of hose are at your disposal: a wide spray and a power jet. Play in two-player mode for super-hot action!

releases.name: The House of Tesla: Definitive Edition
releases.summary:
We invite you to step into the eerie abandoned halls of Tesla's Wardenclyffe facility and uncover the story behind one of history's greatest unfinished innovations: Nikola Tesla's ambitious vision of wireless electricity transmission. You can expect new handcrafted puzzles, hauntingly beautiful locations and challenges for your brain’s gray (or blue) matter. You will be able to look at the world through the eyes of one of the most famous inventors, the father of electricity, the man behind alternating current, the science wizard, Nikola Tesla.
You will need to be industrious and peer under the surface to prevail.

Science brings mysteries toward the light one by one, strips them of their secrets, and makes them part of something greater. It is true that some myths are rooted too deeply, are too resilient, and even seem like having a mind of their own as they resist men of science trying to shine the light of understanding. But in the end, science and mystery are anything but anathema to each other. On one stormy night, a person was brought to this world. A child of darkness and a child of light, full of mysteries and full of scientific curiosity, just starting to build a myth of their own.

You will explore the eerie abandoned industrial buildings of Nikola Tesla’s most ambitious facility in Wardenclyffe, which was meant to become an important city where the future is today and every societal process is improved upon by the principles of free wireless electrical energy.
Through the eyes of the man himself you’ll watch the important moments that lead to the construction and later to the fall of the famous Wardenclyffe Tower, and slowly uncover the mystery that left you stranded among deserted machines.

- Fresh locations based on real places and plans of the enigmatic Nikola Tesla

- Mysterious story from our take on the Progressive Era America

- New dynamic approach to storytelling using flashbacks into the past

- Use a device that allows you to see and influence the flow of electricity

- New handcrafted puzzles to challenge yourself

releases.name: Seicross
releases.summary:
Danger zones, suicide bikers, explosions, and booby traps-all stand in your way as you race your super space bike into the enemy city to rescue the captured people of Petras. Then you must destroy the Dinosaur Tank that is aimed straight at you. 

But, watch out! Your Energy Pack needs to be replaced to keep your bike energized and your laser beam strong.

releases.name: Darkness and Flame: The Dark Side
releases.summary:
Alice and her companions just blew up a dam and buried the army of the Darkness under thousands of tons of water. Victory was practically guaranteed. But the Dark Warrior survived, and created a hurricane so powerful that it nearly killed them all! Alice regains consciousness on the Dark Side of the Great Fissure, a place where nobody has been for decades. To make matters worse, the power of the burning flame has started to fade.

Travel with Alice through dark lands and deserted settlements into the heart of the Dark Side. Are you ready for a difficult, but thrilling journey? Find out in this wonderful Hidden Object Puzzle Adventure!

releases.name: Kitsune Zero
releases.summary:
Run, jump, and stomp on ghostlike creatures from Japanese folklore lurking in the countryside and castles in this prequel to the award winning Kitsune Tails!

Collect powerups that make Yumi grow in size, grant fireball abilities, and make her invincible for a short time. Defeat a sinister samurai gang to stop the clan's war of conquest. Heed the cries of the local onmyouji, a wizardly bureaucrat assigned to keep the peace, and end the magical pact that the samurai have with vengeful spirits. Only Yumi can break the alliance and restore peace... and maybe get to go on a date for her trouble. Gather the necessary ingredients to stop the dark pact's magic and the leader of the samurai clan once and for all. But beware, you may need to save a damsel, err, a dashing gentleman in distress!

releases.name: The Binding of Isaac: Repentance + Online
releases.summary:
For the first time ever on console, descend together. The Binding of Isaac: Repentance+ brings the complete game to console with full online cooperative play for up to four players. Every character, every item, every path, every ending, now with friends online.

Key Features

    Full online cooperative play for up to four players, on console.
    The complete game: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth plus all downloadable content (“Afterbirth,” “Afterbirth+,” “Repentance,” and “Repentance+”).
    Hundreds of items, dozens of characters and endlessly randomized runs.
    Rebalanced items and improvements from years of updates.

releases.name: My Life: Safari Vet
releases.summary: A lion cub needs your help – quick! Grab your vet bag and set off on a wild safari adventure! Examine animals, nurse them back to health, and discover Africa’s amazing wildlife. On foot or in your jeep, your next exciting animal rescue is just around the corner!

releases.name: Goat Simulator 3: Ticket to Dizzyworld
releases.summary:
Welcome to Dizzyworld. An immersive goat-themed baa-musement park, letting you reach higher ups and downs than your mood swings. 

Did you manage to save the Multiverse AND survive the apocalypse?

Take a well-deserved break and feel the g(oat)-force on the many thrilling rides the park has to offer, turn innocent visitors into baalloons, watch them puke, and trade Dizzy Tokens for sweet rewards. 

Sounds like vacation to me. 

Secure your ticket today, enjoy the dizziness later. 

Dizzyworld – where magic sometimes happens
KEY FEATURES:

    Experience all rides from a first-goat perspective

    Use a scooter to rest your tired hooves, or get into a bumper car for a free whiplash

    Cotton candy. If this isn’t a selling point, I don’t know what is

    Visitors and staff have been added for that real-life amusement park feeling

    New goats, gears, achievements, and map to meh around with

    Switch your emotional roller coaster for a real one. Or at least an in-game one

    A jam-packed playground with lots to explore

    Sandbox gameplay à la OG Goat Simulator

releases.name: TX-1 V8
releases.summary:
"TX-1 V.8" is a racing game released by TATSUMI in 1984.
The popular "TX-1" has returned, featuring a variety of upgrades to make the game even easier to play!
You can now recover if your car rolls over or spins out, and it's even possible to jump right over opponents ahead of you.
The eight countries featured in the Grand Prix stages are all new! Enjoy the fresh scenery of each location as you race toward the finish line!

releases.name: Grand Theft Auto VI
releases.summary: Vice City, USA. Jason and Lucia have always known the deck is stacked against them. But when an easy score goes wrong, they find themselves on the darkest side of the sunniest place in America, in the middle of a criminal conspiracy stretching across the state of Leonida – forced to rely on each other more than ever if they want to make it out alive. [GTA VI]

releases.name: Vice: Magic City Mayhem
releases.summary: Vice: Magic City Mayhem is a retro action-adventure game where you fight, collect new items, and upgrade your character as you make your way through bustling nightclubs, scenic beaches, and raptor-infested yachts.

releases.name: Darkness and Flame: Missing Memories
releases.summary: Your uncle Colin is haunted by nightmares of a familiar woman begging him for help. Convinced that he will find answers if only he can remember, he calls on you for help. Now you must set out on a dangerous adventure to find a healer who can restore your uncle's lost memories. But you must hurry - the Darkness is hunting you! Together, you will need to face many trials, solve dozens of puzzles, and ultimately face the dark army threatening the whole world! Will you succeed in time?

releases.name: Savoury Cascade
releases.summary:
Savoury Cascade is a Match-3 puzzle game that combines cooking, challenges, and managing a small café in a cozy experience.

Inherit an old café and your grandmother’s recipe book. Complete 81 levels across 9 chapters at Culinary School, unlock new recipes, and get ready to run your own establishment.

In Story Mode, take on a 16-day season, prepare dishes, serve customers, earn tips, and invest in upgrades for your kitchen. Each day brings new challenges, orders, and opportunities.

Discover 88 dishes, 44 ingredients, and 51 kitchen items. Match ingredients, create special powers, and overcome different obstacles across three difficulty levels.

After completing the campaign, keep sharpening your skills in Endless Mode and aim for new high scores.

releases.name: Dark Rail
releases.summary: Turn-based management roguelike. Command the Inquisition and rule an industrial city on the empire’s edge. Use your train to meet prisoner shipment quotas by hunting heretics and slaying magical beasts. Produce supplies, contain revolt, and sacrifice prisoners to stop the madness.

releases.name: Disney Dreamlight Valley: The Keepsake Sea
releases.summary:
Get ready to dive into an entirely new adventure as you become a magical Merfolk and embark on a sweeping journey across the sea to reach a faraway kingdom, where strange echoes of its past await. Along the way, you’ll meet some unforgettable new friends, including Milo Thatch, Captain Jack Sparrow, and Megara, as you uncover the mysteries waiting beyond the waves.

The Keepsake Sea will introduce brand-new Biomes to explore, mysterious underwater areas to uncover, and new spaces to fully customize. From exploring what lies beneath the surface to discovering the secrets of this faraway kingdom, there’s plenty of adventure waiting for you!

releases.name: Ranger's Path: National Park Simulator
releases.summary:
In Ranger’s Path: National Park Simulator, you take on the everyday responsibilities of a real park ranger in the stunning Faremont National Park. Restore and maintain scenic trails, assist visitors, and document wildlife in a living, breathing ecosystem.

You’ll clear blocked paths, collect litter, fix broken signs - and occasionally drop everything to respond to urgent wildlife sightings or missing hikers. Each day brings new tasks and surprises.

Faremont’s diverse biomes range from dense forests and meadows to winding rivers. With your ranger pickup, you’ll cover long distances along the park’s road network, reaching remote areas filled with natural landmarks like waterfalls, rock formations, and scenic viewpoints.

As you explore, use your camera to observe animal behavior and expand your personal wildlife lexicon. From elusive wolves and majestic eagles to mischievous raccoons, each species adds life to the park’s biological habitat.

releases.name: Tidy Up: Electronic Store Simulator
releases.summary: Bring order to a chaotic electronics store! Pick up misplaced gadgets, find where every item belongs, organize shelves and displays, earn rewards, upgrade your abilities, and transform a messy store into a perfectly organized space.

releases.name: Soul Reaver 2
releases.summary: Raziel returns to various eras of Nosgoth's dark past in his relentless pursuit of Kain. Encounter new enemies as you unearth the mysteries of Nosgoth's ancient races, and expose the schemes behind the corruption of the Pillars, and the vampire genocide. [Eidos Interactive]

releases.name: Moonlight Peaks
releases.summary: Welcome to your new vampiric life in the magical town of Moonlight Peaks. Raise mystical crops, learn spell-casting and potion-making, and befriend – or even romance – the local werewolves, witches, and mermaids in this heartwarming supernatural life-sim. Eternity awaits!

releases.name: Duck Side of the Moon
releases.summary: Waddle and fly as a duck in space! Explore every corner of the galaxy and find curious creatures and materials along the way. Craft gadgets, upgrade your spaceship, and get cozy in this relaxing adventure.

releases.name: POPUCOM
releases.summary: Venture together with your friends on an unknown planet. Use color switching, match-3 shooting, and artifact powers to overcome challenges and keep advancing. What lies ahead of you is an adventure filled with wonder, hope, and much more to discover!

releases.name: Unicorn Academy: Island of Magic
releases.summary: You are invited to join Unicorn Academy! Create a magical connection with your own unicorn and forge friendship bonds with Sophia, Ava, Layla and the other heroes from the se-ries. Wield unicorn magic and discover every corner of Unicorn Island.

releases.name: DONGDA Gangster
releases.summary:
About This Game
Immersed in the turbulent "Tohoku" underworld epicof the 1980s, "Northeast Past" is a real-life interactivevideo game that combines hardcore underworldsurvival rules with multi-branching narratives, takingyou to experience the underworld and get involved inthe bloody fate of gang disputes.

A Star-Studded Team for an Authentic Adaptation
Directed by Kong Ergou, the original author of the novel, the game stays true to the core of the beloved storyline. Di Huangjin, a renowned interactive movie game producer, oversees the entire gameplay experience from concept to release. The original star cast of the IP also returns for this adaptation. While preserving the IP’s iconic essence, we’ve crafted a fresh take on the story, delivering cinematic live-action interactive gameplay that captures the unadulterated spirit of the Northeast underworld and a one-of-a-kind brand of Eastern heroic fervor.

An Iconic IP – Live the Underworld Legend Yourself
The original novel has sold over 40 million copies, and its live-action adaptation is a Douban classic with an 8.8/10 rating! This time, you’re no longer a bystander to the legend—you forge and write your own 20 years of fiery heroism. Step into the Northeast underworld of the 80s and 90s, and make pivotal choices that could either ignite a blazing legacy or lead to total ruin, amid the fire and frost of a transformative era.

Your Choices Shape the Underworld
Play as Zhao Hongbing and navigate the twists and turns of a life of chaos and courage, making choices that split the story into distinct paths at every turn. Stand by your brothers through thick and thin without hesitation, or swallow your pride and endure humiliation just to survive—every decision unlocks a radically different story branch. Will you become a legendary underworld lord? Or will your fiery life burn out too soon, a tragic ballad cut short? Unlock a host of epic, high-stakes endings as you carve your path.

Immersive Era, Meticulous Detail
With top-tier artistic craftsmanship, the game recreates an era where passion and courage ran through every street. From rusted old factory districts to neon-drenched nightclubs, every scene is steeped in the raw, unfiltered energy of 1980s and 90s Northeast China.

Dynamic Relationships, a Vivid Cast of Characters
Every encounter with the classic characters from the live-action series is a collision of fates, forging unbreakable bonds of brotherhood and heroism. The game’s Archive System delves deep into every character’s backstory, breathing life and humanity into them. Uncover hidden character arcs rife with loyalty, betrayal, and unspoken friendship—each one a new layer to the underworld’s rich tapestry.

releases.name: The Canon Keeper
releases.summary:
In The Canon Keeper, the government has destroyed nearly every Bible and replaced Scripture with its own altered version. Fragments of the original Word are still being smuggled through the resistance, and they are brought to your desk so you can determine what is real and what has been changed.

Some fragments are authentic. Some are completely fabricated. Others have only one word changed, but that one word can corrupt the entire meaning of the passage.

Examine Scripture fragments, compare wording, check references, and use the materials available to decide whether each passage should be approved or rejected. The further you get, the harder it becomes to recognize the truth, because the most dangerous lies are the ones that sound almost completely biblical.

releases.name: Reef Defense
releases.summary:
Reef Defense is a fast-paced, intense strategy game where relentless waves of crustaceans are coming for your precious eggs! Arm your reef with strategically positioned defenses and hold the line.

Can you outlast the swarm, or will your eggs become crab food?

releases.name: Cat Simulator
releases.summary:
Welcome to the ultimate playground of cute chaos. You step into the soft paws of a mischievous little kitten with one clear objective: turn every room into your personal playground of total destruction. 

From sprawling suburban houses to sunny yards across three unique locations, you have complete freedom to jump, explore, and knock over every fragile object in sight just for the fun of it.

releases.name: Ski Jumping World Cup
releases.summary:
Ski Jumping World Cup takes players to the world’s most iconic ski jumping hills, offering competition in both single player modes and online matches against opponents from around the globe. Feel the adrenaline of ski jumping as you compete on 18 varied hills, take part in World Cup, or create your own tournament tailored to your preferences.


Push yourself in competitive tournaments, sharpen your technique in practice mode, or challenge players worldwide in thrilling online duels.

Precision. Nerves. Flight.

releases.name: BOMBANANA!
releases.summary: Chaotic bomb disposal fun with friends & monkeys! Work together as a 3-player co-op team of blind, deaf, and mute monkeys. Each player has only part of the needed information. Communicate, solve puzzles, and race against the clock. Can you defuse the bombs before they explode?

releases.name: MOTHERGUNSHIP: FORGE
releases.summary: Craft. Shoot. Die. Repeat. Forge absurdly powerful guns and fight through the belly of a metal alien monstrosity in this VR FPS roguelite follow up to MOTHERGUNSHIP. Wanna build a rocket-firing-shotgun or a toxic spike-ball-launcher? Unleash your inner mad scientist, then take on the MOTHERGUNSHIP.
